text:
Rhea: Heads up — TidalWorks just opened 2 new teams (catalog and alerts) under the same org and kicked off an embeddings sync. Traffic spiked ~2.6x this morning. Noticed hourly bursts. @Diego can you validate capacity impact? :mag:
Diego: Checking. Which project tags?
Rhea: org:tidalworks, projects: catalog-index, alerts-index. They said theyre indexing mixed-format product pages + user alerts.
Lina: PM message: "Rolling out cross-user suggestions + alert dedupe. Need embeddings for ~30k items/day initially, expecting rapid growth if pilot succeeds."
Mira: 30k/day steady is reasonable, but alerts need low-latency updates. Are they doing near-RT or batch?
Rhea: They said near-RT for alerts (minutes). Catalog is batched every hour. Renewal conversation in 4 months — they called this a strategic feature.
capacity-bot: auto-allocated +1 concurrent worker to hosted-pool-2 for org:tidalworks (policy: short-burst).
Diego: Quick perf probe: current p50 ~95ms, p95 ~340ms under burst. With +1 worker p95 drops to ~180ms.
CS-ops: Recommend a 10-day reserved pod as an interim and an enablement session for their infra engineers.
Lina: Also reporting tokenization oddities for product descriptions with embedded JSON blobs — produces inflated token counts. We'll need tokenization tips and a sniff test.
Mira: Suggested batch/concurrency for embedding pipeline:
```json
{"batch_size":128, "concurrency":3, "kv_prefix_cache":true}
```
Diego: I'll run a 2-hour sustained test at expected ingest rates and post logs.
Rhea: Action list: @Diego run sustained perf test + upload logs; @Mira create onboarding checklist + tokenization sniff; @Lina coordinate 30-min enablement session with customer tomorrow 10:30am PT; @CS-ops prepare short reserved pod quote and 30-day growth projection.
Lina: 10:30am PT confirmed with TidalWorks.
Rhea: This looks like an expansion trigger — flagging for renewal playbook and AE touch. Marking as `expansion-signal` in notes.
Mira: Also recommend adding a small eval set to monitor quality as we tune batching/quantization.
Diego: Uploaded preliminary perf traces to the ticket after 2-hour run — p95 holds ~210ms with +1 worker. Will re-run with cache enabled.
Rhea: Thanks all. Follow up in CS sync Monday. :calendar:
